subject: Computação
description_pt: Analisar o consumo de tecnologia na sociedade, compreendendo criticamente o caminho da produção dos recursos bem como aspectos ligados à obsolescência e a sustentabilidade. Selecionar e utilizar tecnologias computacionais para se expressar e resolver problemas, analisando criticamente os diferentes impactos na sociedade.

components.description_pt: Analisar cadeia de produção de recurso tecnológico identificando seus impactos sociais e ambientais
components.description_en: Analyze the production chain of a technological resource identifying its social and environmental impacts
components.cc_component_description: Assess potential social, cultural, and environmental impacts of a proposed engineering solution

components.description_pt: Explicar questões relacionadas à obsolescência tecnológica e sustentabilidade
components.description_en: Explain issues related to technological obsolescence and sustainability
components.cc_component_description: Analyze trade-offs, constraints, and ethical issues when comparing alternative design solutions

components.description_pt: Selecionar tecnologias computacionais apropriadas para expressar ideias ou resolver problema específico
components.description_en: Select computational technologies appropriate for expressing ideas or solving a specific problem
components.cc_component_description: Select appropriate mathematical or computational tools to model a specific phenomenon

components.description_pt: Avaliar criticamente impactos variados do consumo de tecnologia na sociedade
components.description_en: Critically evaluate the varied impacts of technology consumption on society
components.cc_component_description: Assess potential social, cultural, and environmental impacts of a proposed engineering solution

cc_matches.description: Evaluate a solution to a complex real-world problem based on prioritized criteria and trade-offs that account for a range of constraints, including cost, safety, reliability, and aesthetics as well as possible social, cultural, and environmental impacts.
Compare and evaluate competing arguments or design solutions in light of currently accepted explanations, new evidence, limitations (e.g., trade-offs), constraints, and ethical issues.
Use mathematical, computational, and/or algorithmic representations of phenomena or design solutions to describe and/or support claims and/or explanations.
